# Customer Demographics & Demand Analysis: EcoHome Smart Thermostat
Evaluation of Q1 2026 Pilot Survey Data

## Survey Sample Breakdown
A total of 1,200 homeowners were surveyed across four regional territories regarding household income, smart home adoption, and purchase intent for the $249 EcoHome unit.

| Region | Respondents | Median HHI | Homeownership Rate | High Purchase Intent (%) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Northeast | 320 | $94,000 | 68% | 42% |
| Midwest | 260 | $71,000 | 74% | 18% |
| South | 380 | $82,000 | 69% | 35% |
| West | 240 | $108,000 | 62% | 51% |

## Key Findings
- Total survey responses from the Midwest and West combined equaled 560 respondents.
- High purchase intent tracks strongly with median household income above $80,000.
- Across the entire sample, 71% of respondents identified energy bill reduction as their primary purchase driver, while 19% prioritized remote mobile access.

## Target Market Recommendations
- Allocate 45% of Q3 digital ad spend to the Midwest region because it demonstrates the strongest immediate consumer demand.
- Price elasticity remains high among households earning under $75,000; introductory promotional rebates of $30 should be tested in southern retail channels to improve conversion.
- Prioritize direct-to-consumer bundling with utility rebate programs in the Northeast and West, where combined favorable intent exceeds 40% of surveyed cohorts.
